rationales: A force alone does not describe the turning effect used in steering.
Net force is not the specific turning effect illustrated by steering.
A couple produces a turning effect and is used to turn a steering wheel.
Momentum is not the turning effect used in steering.
An electric bulb converts electrical energy mainly into light and heat.
A photocell converts light energy into electrical energy.
An electric generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
An electric cell converts chemical energy into electrical energy.
Kinetic energy is the energy a body has because it is moving.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei.
Chemical energy is stored in chemical bonds.
Potential energy is stored due to position or configuration.
At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100°C, not 98°C.
78°C is not the boiling point of water at standard pressure.
Water’s boiling point at standard atmospheric pressure is 100°C.
90°C is below water’s boiling point at standard atmospheric pressure.
Nm is not the standard unit of momentum; it is a unit of torque or work.
kg m s⁻¹ is a unit of momentum.
N s is also a unit of momentum because impulse has the same dimensions as momentum.
N s⁻¹ is not a unit of momentum; its dimensions differ from momentum.
Speed is distance divided by time, not displacement divided by time.
Acceleration is the change in velocity divided by time.
Velocity is displacement divided by time.
Displacement is the change in position, not the quotient of displacement and time.
The coefficient of friction is the ratio of frictional force to normal reaction, μ = Fₛ/R.
This reverses the ratio used to define the coefficient of friction.
P/W is not the defining ratio for the coefficient of friction.
Fₛ/W uses weight rather than the normal reaction in the general definition.
The weight is 100 kg × 1.6 m s⁻² = 160 N, not 100 N.
The Moon weight is 160 N using W = mg.
1000 N would result from using Earth’s gravitational field approximately.
1600 N is ten times the correct Moon weight.
A force in a plane is resolved into two perpendicular components, not one.
A force has two perpendicular components when resolved in a plane.
Three components may be used in three-dimensional resolution, but not the standard planar resolution asked here.
Four perpendicular components are not used to resolve a force in a plane.
The water in a dam has stored energy before it is used to generate electricity.
Water stored at height in a dam has gravitational potential energy.
Kinetic energy is associated with motion, while dam water is stored at rest.
Nuclear energy is not the energy stored in dam water.
15°C is far below normal human body temperature.
73°C is far above normal human body temperature.
37°F is much colder than normal body temperature and is not the correct Celsius value.
Normal human body temperature is approximately 37°C.
10⁴ N m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10 N m⁻² is ten pascals.
One pascal is equal to 1 N m⁻².
10² N m⁻² is 100 pascals.
1/10 cm equals 0.1 cm and is too large for the usual digital vernier least count.
1/100 cm equals 0.01 cm, the usual least count of a digital vernier caliper.
1/1000 cm is smaller than the usual least count of a digital vernier caliper.
1/10000 cm is smaller than the usual least count of a digital vernier caliper.
The third equation of motion is v_f² = v_i² + 2aS.
The equation gives the square of final velocity, not final velocity itself.
Time squared is not the result of this equation.
Time is not the result of this equation.
FₛR is a product, not the coefficient-of-friction ratio.
The coefficient of friction is frictional force divided by normal reaction: μ = Fₛ/R.
R/Fₛ reverses the correct ratio.
FₛR² is not the definition of the coefficient of friction.
